question: In a certain code language, MONEY is written as PRQHB. In the same code language, CREDIT will be written as:
solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

MONEY is written as PRQHB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77674e9c23f4fa708b96cf270b5c9c90613a711810d75b9113391bc5c8d91b9a.png] 

Similarly,

'**CREDIT**' = ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c6609abe683525cb031039877ec53ec2880319ce45bb20cb2b153d105919cce.png] 

Hence, 'CREDIT' is coded as "**FUHGLW**".
